subject: Request: CCPA sale classification, deletion evidence, and subprocessor onboarding steps
messages:
From: Samantha Ruiz <s.ruiz@healthmate.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthmate.com
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial request: CCPA classification + RFI attached

Hi Mina and Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — HealthMate is moving quickly and procurement asked me to surface a few legal/privacy items before we proceed with the pilot. I attached our standard DPO RFI (HealthMate_DPO_RFI_template.xlsx). Please see the asks below: 

1) CCPA/CPRA "sale" question: we need a clear statement on whether Redwood's telemetry/usage signals (IP address, request metadata, model prompts/outputs that are logged for quota/rate-limit and billing telemetry) are treated in a way that would constitute a "sale" under CCPA/CPRA or whether Redwood considers that data processing solely as a service-provider activity. Concrete language for our DPA/ADDENDUM would be helpful.

2) Deletion proof: for test accounts we created last month, we need an example report or process description showing how deletion is performed and how you would prove deletion of customer-specific telemetry.

3) Subprocessors & onboarding: list of current subprocessors involved in telemetry/analytics and the expected timeline to onboard an onshore fallback (if needed). Do you provide advance notice for new subprocessors and an emergency onshore alternative?

4) Evidence: SOC 2 artifacts or a read-only link for a current snapshot would expedite our internal review.

Target: procurement would like a response + any redlines by 2025-04-18 so we can include the addendum in our PO. Appreciate a short runbook and any templated addendum language you can provide.

Thanks,
Samantha Ruiz
DPO (contracting) | HealthMate Inc.
procurement@healthmate.com

Attachment: HealthMate_DPO_RFI_template.xlsx

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <s.ruiz@healthmate.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial request: CCPA classification + RFI attached

Thanks Samantha — got this and appreciate the clear asks.

High-level next steps from our side:
- I'll own the technical/deployment answers and produce a short deletion runbook (example commands and retention windows) and a sample deletion proof report.
- Ben will coordinate procurement/contract flow and get you a redlineable addendum.
- Karthik (legal) is looped for the CCPA/CPRA classification language and recommended contract text.
- We can provide a secure, time-limited link to our SOC 2 snapshot — will confirm below.

Quick clarifying Qs so we respond precisely:
1) When you say "telemetry/usage signals" can you confirm whether HealthMate considers model prompts/outputs that are logged for debugging (scrubbed of PII) to be within scope of the RFI? This affects whether we treat that data as "service-related processing" vs potential marketing/sale use.
2) Do you need the deletion proof for production accounts only, or would a dev/test account example suffice for procurement?

I'll follow up with the deletion runbook and a draft addendum by early next week.

- Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Samantha Ruiz <s.ruiz@healthmate.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial request: CCPA classification + RFI attached

Samantha / Mina / Ben — quick legal summary and suggested contract language below. Attaching a redline we can start with (redwood_dpa_addendum_v2.pdf).

Short answer on "sale": Redwood's current telemetry collection and usage for billing, rate-limiting, QoS, and service-improvement (aggregated model performance metrics or non-PII debugging logs) is handled as "service-provider" processing under CCPA/CPRA. We do not disclose customer personal information to third parties for monetary consideration or for advertising purposes. For clarity in your DPA/addendum, we recommend the following paragraph (suggested language):

"Redwood Inference acts as a Service Provider under applicable US state privacy laws (including CCPA/CPRA) with respect to telemetry and operational logs. Telemetry collected for billing, reliability, and service improvement is processed solely for the performance of the services and is not sold, shared, or used for advertising or cross-context behavioral targeting. Redwood will not retain personally-identifiable information beyond the retention periods specified in the Agreement and will provide deletion reports upon request."

Subprocessor onboarding / onshore fallback:
- Current subprocessors involved in telemetry/analytics: AmpliSearch Analytics (US), LogHarbor (US), CloudQueue (multi-region).
- If HealthMate requires an onshore-only fallback for telemetry, we can commit to an onshore fallback pool for an additional onboarding timeline of approximately 6-8 weeks (subject to contract).
- Redwood provides 30 days advance notice for new subprocessors and an emergency notice path for critical security changes.

Deletion evidence & sample artifacts:
- We will provide a deletion runbook (commands, timeframe, verification checks) and a sample deletion report for a dev/test account. For production proof, we can provide an audit trace showing the deletion event id + checksum confirmation. The deletion report is generated automatically from our audit logs.

Evidence package: SOC 2 Type 2 snapshot (read-only link) + redlined addendum attached. If HealthMate needs notarized or third-party-validated proofs beyond SOC 2, we can discuss a tailored package.

Next steps:
1) Mina to deliver deletion runbook and technical evidence (by EOD 2025-04-15).
2) Ben to share procurement redline/docuSign workflow.
3) We attach redwood_dpa_addendum_v2.pdf for review — please comment and return with any redlines.

-Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial request: CCPA classification + RFI attached

Thanks Karthik (and team) — this is helpful and in line with what procurement expects. A few quick confirmations before we circulate internally: 

- Thanks for the suggested paragraph — we'll include that in our addendum section that maps to CCPA definitions.
- For evidence, a dev/test deletion report is fine for initial review. We will escalate to production-level proofs if the pilot moves to a full rollout.
- On subprocessors: please send the definitive list and an electronic notice cadence; the 30-day notice and emergency path is acceptable. The onshore fallback of 6-8 weeks is tight but workable if we need it.

Attached: our filled RFI (HealthMate_DPO_RFI_filled.xlsx). Procurement would like the redline addendum in DocuSign-friendly format; can Ben share the DocuSign workflow/expected signer list? We are aiming to sign by 2025-04-18.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Samantha Ruiz
DPO (contracting) | HealthMate Inc.
procurement@healthmate.com

Attachment: HealthMate_DPO_RFI_filled.xlsx
